text: Tameeni is operated by Tameeni Company (Tameeni Electronic Insurance Brokerage), a wholly owned subsidiary that Rasan Information Technology Company established in November 2022.
short: Tameeni is a wholly owned subsidiary of Rasan

source.name: Rasan Information Technology Company Prospectus (CMA), Definition of terms / Group history
source.quote: The Group has since established a wholly owned subsidiary in November 2022G, Tameeni Company, which obtained the requisite SAMA e-brokerage license in May 2023G
source.note: The prospectus's definitions (p. 59) identify Tameeni Company as 'Tameeni Electronic Insurance Brokerage Single Person Company ... wholly by the Company'; its subsidiaries table (p. 249) shows Rasan holding 100% of Tameeni Company.

additionalSources.name: Rasan — IPO page (company website)
additionalSources.quote: providing seamless services through our flagship subsidiaries, including Tameeni
additionalSources.note: Same publisher as the prospectus (the company itself), kept as corroboration only.
